# TSF Fitness Studio

> Combat sports and fitness studio in Caranzalem, Goa, India. Founded in 2018 by Master Suresh. Offers MMA, Taekwondo, CrossFit, Calisthenics, Yoga, Kickboxing, Gymnastics, Dance, and Personal Training for adults and kids.

TSF (Team Suresh Fitness) is a martial arts and fitness institution in Caranzalem, Goa. It has operated since 2018 and is led by founder and head coach Master Suresh, a second-degree black belt in Taekwondo, President of the SaJa Taekwondo Association of Goa (STAG), and Head Coach of Goa under the Indian International Taekwondo Federation (IITF).

The studio occupies 500 square meters and runs programs for both adults and children. Coaching emphasises technique before intensity, and sessions are open to all skill levels from complete beginners to competitive fighters.

## Programs

### Adults

- **Kickboxing & MMA Training** — ₹3,000/month. Monday to Saturday. Morning 7:00–8:00 AM, evening 7:00–8:30 PM.
- **CrossFit Training** — ₹3,000/month. Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. Morning batches 8:00–9:00 AM and 9:00–10:00 AM.
- **Calisthenics** — ₹3,000/month. Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. Evening 6:00–7:00 PM.
- **Yoga** — ₹3,000/month. Monday, Wednesday, Friday. Morning batches 8:00–9:00 AM and 9:00–10:00 AM.
- **Personal Training** — One-on-one sessions by appointment. On request.

### Kids

- **Kickboxing** — ₹3,000/month. Monday, Wednesday, Friday. 5:00–6:00 PM.
- **Taekwondo** — ₹2,500/month. Monday, Wednesday, Friday. 6:00–7:00 PM.
- **Yoga** — ₹3,000/month. Monday, Wednesday, Friday. 5:00–6:00 PM.
- **Gymnastics** — ₹3,000/month. Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. 6:00–7:00 PM.
- **Calisthenics** — ₹3,000/month. Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday. 5:00–6:00 PM.
- **Dance** — Tuesday, Thursday. 4:00–5:00 PM. On request.

## Founder

**Master Suresh** is the founder and head coach of TSF Fitness Studio.

- Second-degree black belt in Taekwondo
- Ten-plus years of coaching experience
- President of STAG (SaJa Taekwondo Association of Goa)
- Head Coach of Goa under IITF (Indian International Taekwondo Federation)
- Certified Personal Trainer and Certified Martial Arts Trainer
- Also founder of JuicyBites Healthy Cafe in Goa
